data_dependencies: causal 24/7 crypto trades, quotes, venue, pair, reference, and market-regime data
verified Robinhood crypto account, jurisdiction, tradable-pair, quote, review, order, fill, custody, and fee capabilities for any future live contract
explicit exchange, stablecoin, fork, maintenance, and market-wide event context
causal_inputs.decision_time_rule: Freeze venue, pair, quote, liquidity, regime, and event evidence at each research timestamp.
causal_inputs.completed_bar_rule: Use a separately versioned 24/7 bar/session clock; equity completed-bar, open, gap, and holiday rules may not be transferred.
causal_inputs.missing_data_rule: Venue, pair, account, jurisdiction, fee, spread, or 24/7 risk inputs remain UNKNOWN and prohibit executability claims.

setup_rules: UNKNOWN until a causal 24/7 session model, liquidity regime, momentum transition, and market-wide correlation model are versioned
equity gap, opening-range, and same-clock RVOL definitions are not admissible
entry_or_research_rules: research observations only; no broker review, crypto order, risk authorization, buying-power reservation, or allocation
freeze venue/pair intersection, trigger, quote, spread, depth, fee, invalidation, and horizon at T
exit_or_outcome_rules: UNKNOWN until continuous monitoring, maintenance, weekend, outage, gap, and execution models are prospectively defined
outcomes must remain venue- and pair-specific and include all fees and executable spread/slippage
invalidations: venue or pair mismatch, jurisdiction or account ineligibility, stale or fragmented quote, maintenance, stablecoin depeg, failed liquidity, or undefined 24/7 monitoring
any attempted LIVE, PAPER, broker, risk, or allocation action under this SHADOW-only contract

notes: Connector, account, jurisdiction, tradable-pair, quote, and 24/7 risk readiness are unverified.
This contract cannot authorize crypto trading.

lane_risk_translation.notional_rule: UNKNOWN; no crypto quantity, buying power, custody balance, or capital is authorized or reserved.
lane_risk_translation.stop_defined_risk_rule: UNKNOWN until venue-specific stop support, continuous quote availability, and outage behavior are verified.
lane_risk_translation.stress_loss_rule: Must model weekend gaps, fragmented liquidity, venue outage, depeg, fork, maintenance, and correlated crypto drawdown tails.
lane_adjustments: separate each venue/pair, stablecoin quote currency, liquidity tier, and weekday/weekend regime
use 24/7 time-of-week baselines rather than equity-session RVOL
no equity loss-lock or closeout assumption is transferable without a new crypto-specific contract

cost_execution_model.quote_source: UNKNOWN until a venue-specific executable Robinhood crypto quote workflow is verified.
cost_execution_model.spread_model: UNKNOWN; consolidated or third-party market data cannot prove the executable broker spread.
cost_execution_model.slippage_model: UNKNOWN; must include fragmentation, weekend, outage, depeg, and liquidation-wave slippage.
cost_execution_model.fee_model: UNKNOWN; must include exact broker spread/fee treatment and may not silently assume zero.
cost_execution_model.fill_model: UNKNOWN; venue-specific order behavior and partial fills must be causally modeled.
cost_execution_model.maximum_contractual_loss_rule: Long spot maximum nominal loss is deployed notional, but stress, custody, venue, and depeg risks must be reported separately.

session_calendar_rules.calendar: Continuous 24/7 crypto calendar with venue maintenance and time-of-week regimes
session_calendar_rules.research_or_entry_window: SHADOW research only; no active entry window.
session_calendar_rules.mandatory_flat_rule: UNKNOWN_NOT_ACTIVATED; any future holding and downtime policy requires a new explicit crypto contract.
session_calendar_rules.holiday_rule: Equity holidays do not close crypto; holiday and weekend liquidity regimes must be labeled independently.

entry_or_research_kill_conditions: venue, pair, account, jurisdiction, custody, fee, or quote workflow unverified
24/7 session, outage, maintenance, or tail-risk model absent
future leakage or equity-model transfer detected
any non-SHADOW book mode or nonzero trade, risk, reservation, or allocation authority
suspension_criteria.operator_stop_semantics: Registered SHADOW research is zero-authority; it cannot alter, release, or bypass the LIVE emergency-entry stop.

known_failure_modes: continuous trading makes equity-session assumptions invalid
fragmented venue liquidity can make one feed non-executable
weekend and overnight gaps can exceed modeled exits
account and jurisdiction eligibility can change independently of market data
